item.title: GSoC Week 15: Owning the Recursion
item.description: This is the last week of coding, and it landed on the piece of work that everything else this summer had been quietly building toward: turning manualintegrate's tangle of self-recursive rules into a single IntegrationSolver that owns the recursion on their behalf.

item.title: GSoC Week 14: The Stateful Solver Lands
item.description: Back in week two, I noticed that a lot of manualintegrate's worst performance problems traced back to the same place: AlternativesRule generating too many candidate strategies and the search exploding underneath them. At the time all I had was a vague idea that the integrator needed something closer to a guided search than a pile of heuristics. This week that idea finally became code. PR 30311, the single largest thing I have touched all summer, migrated manualintegrate onto a stateful-solver architecture, and it took 79 commits in seven days to get there.
